headline: Putin Issues Second Asset Seizure Decree Deepening Japan Tobacco Expropriation
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin issued a second asset seizure decree further advancing the expropriation of Japan Tobacco's assets in the country.
why: Asset seizures and expropriations of foreign multinational subsidiaries escalate geopolitical and investment risks for foreign corporations operating in Russia.

impacts.name: Japan Tobacco
impacts.why: Expropriation of local assets destroys capital value and operational footprint for the parent corporation.

why_moved: State expropriation of corporate assets directly destroys shareholder value and eliminates regional revenue streams.
